# The Micheli Center

> > The Micheli Center provides specialized sports medicine, athletic training, and injury prevention services with expertise in running gait retraining, performing arts medicine, and functional movement assessment.

Based in Waltham, Massachusetts, The Micheli Center offers comprehensive sports medicine and rehabilitation services. The center's staff includes certified athletic trainers and specialists trained in evidence-based methodologies including the Functional Movement System (FMS), Hesch Method, and Medical Therapeutic Yoga (MYT), serving athletes, dancers, and adaptive populations.

## Key Topics

- Athletic Training
- Injury Prevention
- Running Gait Retraining
- Functional Movement System (FMS)
- Performing Arts Medicine
- Hypermobility
- Chronic Pain Management
- Medical Therapeutic Yoga (MYT)
- Hesch Method
- Adaptive Populations
- ACSM Certification
- Dance Medicine
- Marathon Training
- Personal Training

## Staff & Specialists

- [Sara Collins, LAT, ATC, CPT](https://www.themichelicenter.com/saracollins): Athletic trainer specializing in gait analysis, injury prevention, and functional movement assessment
